ttps.justification: Technique applies because: code injection. The Process Injection technique is relevant because this vulnerability's attack mechanism aligns with Defense Evasion / Privilege Escalation phase behavior described in ATT&CK v16.
ttps.observed_behavior: Based on the vulnerability description, an adversary exploiting 'Exploit for Code Injection in Vmware Spring_Cloud_Function' would employ Process Injection (T1055) during the Defense Evasion / Privilege Escalation phase. The exploitation mechanism directly enables the Defense Evasion / Privilege Escalation objective.
ttps.detection_hint: Monitor for cross-process memory writes, VirtualAllocEx/WriteProcessMemory API calls, and unusual thread creation in high-value processes (lsass, svchost, explorer).
ttps.kql_example: DeviceEvents | where ActionType == 'CreateRemoteThreadApiCall' | where InitiatingProcessFileName != FileName
